deploy-bot: queued by @zoe for 2024-06-10T09:00:00Z (job db-12399). Command:
```
/deploy staged --model v5.2.0-fp16 --stages 10,50,100 --region eu --notify #eng-oncall
```

"INTERNAL: Staged EU rollout v5.2.0-fp16  Tue 09:00 UTC. Owner: @morgan. Fallback: v5.1.7. Targets: p95 <=130ms, errors <0.45%. Embargo until 11:00 UTC. Deploy-bot will pause on soft threshold; hard rollback -> immediate pin & revert. Dashboard: https://grafana.company/redwood/eu-staggered"
